status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Engine 0.1.1-rc.16 and the site comparison are inlined into server.mjs. The engine was published to npm on 2026-10-01 under the next tag; the bundle is built from the archive whose SHA-256 is below, which npm's tarball matches. Bundling keeps one copy of the comparison rules.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard. The record and receipt schemas are drafts.

changedSince: rc.1 to rc.10, rc.14, rc.15 and rc.16 remain unchanged as separate archives; there were no rc.11 to rc.13 archives. The engine is the same 0.1.1-rc.16, so every position, angle, cusp and comparison is rc.16's. New in rc.16.1: each of the three tools declares an output schema, and the server checks every result other than a refusal against it before sending it; every such result carries cite, the url of the tool's entry on the developer page, the SHA-256 of a receipt's RFC 8785 canonical JSON, and the engine and its version, the shape the compute API uses; get_capabilities and compare_calculation_records carry the adapter's own receipt, which holds nothing from a record; two resources, zodiacs://conventions and zodiacs://methodology, give the conventions vocabulary of the records and how the server calculates; and get_capabilities labels the engine as published on npm (since 2026-10-01, under the next tag), where rc.16 said unpublished-candidate. The tools' names and arguments are unchanged. The adapter itself is still not on npm.
